notes.title: 🤖 AI Support, New Features, and Ongoing Developments!
notes.content:
📢 New Update is Live!

With this update, we have added AI support to Rotten Deck and RPS: Minus One modes! Now, you can test your skills against AI opponents. You can enable or disable this option when creating a lobby. If a real player joins, the AI will automatically leave.

⚡ New Features:

Lobby hosts can now kick players from the lobby. No more dealing with unwanted players!
🐞 Bug Fixes:

Fixed typos and spelling errors in certain languages.
Fixed an issue that allowed selecting more than six keys.
🛠 Ongoing Developments:

Host Migration (A more stable system for connection drops)
ESC Mute (Quickly mute players with the ESC key)
Achievements System (New achievements coming soon!)
New Game Mode: Blackjack Roulette
Jump into the game now and experience the new features! 🎮🔥 We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: 🔧 Only False Patch Notes
notes.content:
The latest update makes Only False smoother and more polished! Here’s what’s new:
	•	🎥 Camera fix: Now properly aligns with where you’re looking.
	•	🤖 Smoother camera and head movements: No more stuttering, everything moves fluidly.
	•	📜 Leaderboard text fix: No more text overflow issues.
	•	🔘 Discord button fix: No longer appears in the room creation menu unnecessarily.
	•	🚀 Performance improvements: Optimized for a more stable gameplay experience.

Download the update now and enjoy a smoother Only False experience! 🔥
